tasks.title: K2: curate ≥12 hypotheses from existing repo research only
tasks.description: Fill docs/research/knowledge/hypotheses/ with at least 12 JSON files (one hypothesis per file, filename = id + .json) curated ONLY from existing repo docs: docs/research/Tango_music_synthesis.md, milonga_story1.md, milonga_story2.md, docs/product/MUSICALITY_OVERHAUL.md, ENGINE_KNOWLEDGE_REGISTRY.md, COMPOSE_LAB_SPEC.md, PROJECT_PLAN.md. Cover kinds: sentence (≥3), progression (≥3), rhythm (≥3), form (≥2). Each file MUST validate against docs/research/knowledge/hypothesis.schema.json. evidence[] must cite repo paths/sections (e.g. 'docs/research/Tango_music_synthesis.md §2'). Do NOT fetch MuseScore, PDMX score bytes, or the web for new copyrighted examples. Do NOT change engine code in this task.
acceptance:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
root = pathlib.Path('docs/research/knowledge/hypotheses')
schema = json.load(open('docs/research/knowledge/hypothesis.schema.json'))
req = set(schema['required'])
files = sorted(root.glob('*.json'))
assert len(files) >= 12, len(files)
kinds = {}
for p in files:
    o = json.load(open(p))
    assert req <= set(o), (p, req - set(o))
    assert p.stem == o['id'], (p, o['id'])
    kinds[o['kind']] = kinds.get(o['kind'], 0) + 1
    assert o['evidence'], p
assert kinds.get('sentence', 0) >= 3
assert kinds.get('progression', 0) >= 3
assert kinds.get('rhythm', 0) >= 3
assert kinds.get('form', 0) >= 2
print('hypotheses ok', len(files), kinds)
PY
